[Shift-share (Bartik) instruments]{.alert} are widely used in applied work

* An instrument is constructed by combining [shares]{.alert-blue} (local
  exposure to some set of sectors) with [shifts]{.alert-blue} (aggregate,
  sector-level changes)

[This session:]{.alert} what identifies a shift-share design, how it relates
to the panel data arguments from the first two sessions, and what to be
careful about
